page.overview:
What is Andustar?

Andustar, or the Westlands, was the western province of Númenor, separated from the Hyarnustar to the south by the wide Bay of Eldanna.

It was known as the region where the city of Andúnië, the haven of the Faithful, was built.

Andustar was roughly rectangular in shape and size, measuring about 240 kilometers from west to east and 160 kilometers from north to south. To the east, it bordered the Forostar and Mittalmar regions, but as a coastal land, it was surrounded in all other directions by the Great Sea. It also bordered the small coastal region of Nísimaldar to the south.

Andustar was a fertile region, with the exception of the northern coast, where the rockier terrain was forested with firs. Its western shores were broken by two bays, the northernmost of which was the Bay of Andúnië. On the high land around this bay, the Númenóreans built Andúnië, the main city and port of Andustar, whose Lords of Andúnië were to be the ancestors of the Kings of Arnor and the Kings of Gondor. Further to the northwest, a second haven and shoreland town named Almaida was built along the Bay of Andúnië.
